key_impacts: Over 13 lakh (1.3 million) people were evacuated before landfall.
Subsequent floods killed 23 in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; significant flooding also reported in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic.
evidence_snippets: On 12 Oct 2013, Phailin Cyclone crossed the coastline south of the city of Brahmapur in Odisha.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Due to the cyclone there were 21 deaths; subsequent floods claimed 23 more in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
